name: Turso Open Graph social card by turso.tech
description: A 1200×630 share card built on a single centred axis: a small mint mascot-plus-wordmark lockup sits at the top, and a three-line stacked headline fills the middle with two key words picked out in mint green against a near-black navy field. The type is an extremely heavy geometric sans at roughly 110px with tight line-height, so the card stays legible at thumbnail size. Everything else is suppressed — no URL, buttons or imagery — letting the negative space make the two-colour headline the entire message.
